output.population: People with type 2 diabetes in 73 randomized controlled trials across eight dietary patterns
output.comparator: Usual diet and other dietary patterns
output.outcome: Body weight, HbA1c, blood pressure, and lipids at 6 and 12 months
output.effect: All dietary patterns reduced body weight and HbA1c after 6 months versus usual diet; largest body-weight effect was low-carbohydrate at -4.8 kg and largest HbA1c effect was Mediterranean at -1.0%; 12-month effects were not statistically significant and evidence was insufficient to select one optimal pattern.
output.applicability_boundary: Network meta-analysis of heterogeneous randomized trials in type 2 diabetes; longer-term 12-month effects were not statistically significant.
